scope: Publication safety and focused synthetic/unit integration; not a new model run, full clean-room retraining, organizer eligibility certification, or approval to execute ocean_v2 T0-T8.

tests.runner: .venv-p1/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q -o addopts= <all 21 new test modules selected by explicit discovery>
tests.selection: new tests/test_*.py returned by git ls-files --others --exclude-standard tests

notebooks.inspection: aggregate metrics/hash/QA only; no raw observations, labels or prediction rows

research_review.authorship: Documents identify Claude; Fable execution identity is not independently proven.

git_safety.whitespace_audit: With cr-at-eol, 10 pre-existing trailing-space or blank-EOF findings remain in supplied/earlier Markdown. Preserved without rewriting original documents; not code failures. Default diff --check also flags intentionally byte-preserved CRLF JSON/notebooks.
git_safety.publication: explicit paths only; no force push/rebase/reset
